prompt:
Use case: realistic photographic context assets for the Chinese character 饼 in a children's Hanzi learning project. The internal asset ID is bread, but the pictured meaning is Chinese flat cakes and biscuits, NEVER Western loaf bread.
Primary request: one 1024x1792 vertical triptych containing exactly three independent horizontal landscape photographs stacked in approximately equal-height panels, separated by two thin straight pure-white horizontal seams. No text.
Top photograph — exact context 一张烙饼: one whole Chinese laobing, a round fairly flat pan-cooked wheat flatcake resting on a plain plate on a light wooden table. Show the complete circular outline and naturally golden surface with irregular brown toasted patches and subtle layered dough texture. A single flatcake, not a loaf, not toast and not a stack. A gently elevated viewpoint shows its flat form.
Middle photograph — exact context 一张煎饼: one whole thin Chinese jianbing pancake, spread open as a large flat round crepe on a simple plain plate. Show its complete circular edge, delicate thinness, golden tan color, tiny cooked bubbles and slight natural wrinkles. This is a single Chinese grain pancake without fillings, not a thick fluffy American pancake, omelet, wrapped sandwich or bread loaf. View from slightly above.
Bottom photograph — exact context 几块方形饼干: a few complete square golden biscuits arranged loosely on a plain shallow plate on a neutral table. Each biscuit has a clearly square outline, small docking holes, crisp baked texture and fine browned edges. All biscuits are fully visible, distinct and unwrapped; no round cookies or slices of bread.
Style and light: photorealistic food photographs, natural window daylight, tactile cooked dough and crisp crumb surfaces, real ceramic glaze, wooden grain and soft contact shadows. Each panel is an independent tabletop scene. No cooking action.
Composition and safety: each whole flatcake and all square biscuits are centered with generous margins; show complete plates and do not crop circular edges or biscuit corners. No people, hands, eating, hot pans, flames or knives. Absolutely no loaf bread, sliced sandwich bread, buns or baguettes anywhere. No text, labels, captions, Chinese characters, logos, watermark, cartoon, illustration, diagram or decorative border.
reviewNotes: Inspected only a 300x525 JPEG preview. Top is one round layered browned 烙饼; middle is one thin open round 煎饼 with cooked bubble texture; bottom is four square golden biscuits with docking holes and lightly scalloped square edges. Some biscuits overlap, but their complete outer corners remain inside the panel. Whole flatcakes and plate outlines are contained, with comparatively modest clearance on the larger middle pancake. No loaf or sliced Western bread, people, cooking action, knives or visible text. Sharp raw RGB white seam bands measure 588–597 and 1184–1192, centers 593 and 1188.
